decision.explanation: The question asks for the release date/year of Xenoblade Chronicles 2. Source D3S2 explicitly states the release date as 'December 1, 2017', which matches candidate C0 and is retained in R5. Source D2S1 identifies the game as a '2017' title, matching candidate C1 and retained in R5. Candidate C2 ('December 21, 2007') originates from D1S2; however, this date is factually inconsistent with the game being a 2017 Nintendo Switch title (announced Jan 2017) and likely represents a hallucination or error in the source text regarding the specific year (2007 vs 2017). Given the explicit confirmation of 2017 in D2 and D3, the 2007 date is rejected as an error. Candidate C3 ('January 12, 2017') is the announcement date (D1S1/D3S1), not the release date, so it is excluded.
